bio:
40+ years of experience across the Middle East, Africa and Europe, building his international banking excellence at the likes of Merrill Lynch, then to JP Morgan and Deutsche Bank where he left as a Managing Director, until he joined CIB in 1999 .
Hisham  has been chairman  of CIB since 2002 till October 2020 , He transformed the institution from a wholesale lender into Egypt’s largest private-sector bank
 The bank’s market capitalization has grown from EGP 1 billion ( $ 200 million ) at the beginning of Mr. Ezz Al-Arab’s term to EGP 100 billion (  $ 6.6 B ), making its stock — a blue chip component of the Egyptian Exchange — the global investment community’s preferred proxy for Egypt and a benchmark for the banking industry in emerging markets. Core to the bank’s success is its unique culture, which balances an entrepreneurial spirit that prizes innovation with a commitment to global best practices in both corporate governance and risk management. Mr. Ezz Al Arab brought to life the CIB Foundation, which is a leading Egyptian voice for universal access to quality healthcare extended to underprivileged children.
 CIB was named Euromoney’s Best Bank in the Middle East and Best Bank in Global Emerging Markets for 2017 and best emerging markets bank by global finance twice 2018 and 2020 , thus becoming the first bank in Egypt, Africa and the Middle East to ever win this award.
 Mr. Ezz Al-Arab was recognized in 2016 by Euromoney for his “Outstanding Contribution to Financial Services in the Middle East” and was EMEA Finance’s “Best CEO in Egypt and Africa” at the magazine’s 2014 Banking Awards.
 Mr. Ezz Al Arab is the former chairperson of the Federation of Egyptian Banks , He is also the chairman of Board of Trustees of the CIB Foundation , a former member of the Board of Trustees of the American University in Cairo, Egypt’s premier private university , former board member of smart Africa , former board member of Fairfax Africa, Member of the IIF Washington , member of EMAC at IIF and board member of Ripplewood advisors MENA .

His mandate was pushing the competitive advantage of data as corporate assets by blending the economic and business knowledge with Data Science to drive incremental value for the business through improved business performance, better marketing leads, insights and customer satisfaction, engagement experience and safe guard the bank applying a sophisticated risk and fraud detection models. 
In recognition, for Islam’s extensive efforts on the data front London Business School (LBS) featured CIB’s data transformation as a case study in 2018, making CIB the first Middle Eastern company to be analyzed in a case study by the Masters in Analytics students. Shortly afterwards, Harvard Business School followed suit and started using the case study in its curriculum. Thus, having the two top business schools in the world recognizing the success story that has been achieved. 
Moreover, Islam is a steering committee member in Smart Africa, an International alliance that spans across half the continent with the purpose of accelerating sustainable socioeconomic development on the continent. He is also one of the actively contributing members in the EUAU Digital Economy Task Force, which is concerned with the possible ways of cooperation in the field of digital economy between Europe and Africa. 
Islam was leading the team responsible for multiple prestigious awards and international recognition from global institutions such Euromoney, Global Finance, International institute of Finance (IIF), Carnegie Mellon University and Digital Awards 50.

bio:
a curious and driven Data engineer with a passion for uncovering insights, optimizing workflows, and solving complex challenges with data. I thrive at the intersection of data engineering, analytics, and AI, always looking for ways to make data more accessible, efficient, and impactful.

I specialize in data engineer, visualization, with hands-on experience in SQL, Python, kafka, AWS, Power BI, and Apache Airflow. From ETL pipelines to ML models, I love building scalable solutions that drive real business impact.
how i think
I see every problem as a system—break it down, optimize it, and ensure everything is connected and resilient. Whether it’s structuring data workflows, enhancing customer retention with analytics, or fine-tuning chatbots & NLP models, I bring a systematic, data-driven approach to every challenge.
what drives me
I believe in continuous learning, whether it’s mastering Google Looker Studio for business visuals, understanding telecom SSIS projects, or exploring machine learning for smarter decision-making. I also enjoy teaching & mentoring, helping others make sense of data just as I do.
you’ll find me teaching coding & data to kids, experimenting with chatbot development, or enhancing my English & communication skills. I enjoy breaking down complex concepts into simple, engaging insights—because data should tell a story, not just be numbers.
